title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Adjudication of Disputes Involving Transferred and Dissolved Enterprises of the Military, Armed Police Forces, and Political-Legal Organs as well as Enterprises Delinked from Party and Government Organs

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where an enterprise established by the military, armed police forces, political and legal organs, and Party and government organs (hereinafter referred to as the established enterprise) meets the conditions for being a legal person and has obtained a business license for a legal person enterprise, it shall, in accordance with Article 60 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, independently bear civil liability with all its property.

Article 2 Where an established enterprise has obtained a business license for a legal person enterprise, and although the actually invested funds do not match the registered capital, it has reached the amount specified in Item 7 of Article 12 of the Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Registration of Enterprise Legal Persons, it shall be deemed to have the qualification of a legal person, and the establishing unit shall bear civil liability within the difference between the actually invested funds and the registered capital.

Article 3 Where an established enterprise has obtained a business license for a legal person enterprise, but the invested funds have not reached the amount specified in Item 7 of Article 12 of the Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Registration of Enterprise Legal Persons, or it does not meet other conditions for being an enterprise legal person, it shall be deemed not to have the qualification of a legal person, and its civil liability shall be borne by the establishing unit.

Article 4 Where an establishing unit withdraws, transfers funds or conceals property to evade the debts of the established enterprise, it shall return the withdrawn, transferred funds or concealed property to be used for settling the debts of the established enterprise.

Article 5 Where an establishing unit or its competent authority, at the time of the dissolution of the established enterprise, provides documentary evidence to the administrative authority for industry and commerce, voluntarily undertaking to assume liability for the debts of the established enterprise, it shall, in accordance with its commitment, bear civil liability for the debts of the established enterprise.

Article 6 Where an establishing unit has already borne civil liability within the scope of the shortfall in registered capital of the established enterprise, it shall be deemed that the registered capital of the establishing unit has been fully contributed, and it shall no longer continue to bear liability for the shortfall in registered capital.
II. Handling of Bankruptcy Cases of Enterprises Being Transferred, Dissolved, or Severed

Article 7 Where an established enterprise or its creditor applies to the People's Court for bankruptcy, regardless of whether the registered capital of the establishing unit has been fully contributed in place, the People's Court shall accept the application.

Article 8 Where an established enterprise is declared bankrupt, the establishing unit's unpaid registered capital, collected funds and physical assets, transferred funds, or concealed property shall all be recovered by the liquidation group.

Article 9 Where an established enterprise has not yet repaid funds raised from the public or from its internal employees, at the time of distribution of bankruptcy property, it shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Item 1 of Paragraph 1 of Article 113 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China.
III. Property Preservation and Enforcement

Article 10 When the People's Court, in hearing a case concerning an enterprise being transferred, dissolved, or severed, determines that the establishing unit shall bear civil liability, it shall not take preservation and enforcement measures such as seizure, attachment, freezing, or auction against the establishing unit's treasury funds, military funds, fiscal appropriation accounts, office premises, vehicles, or other office necessities.
IV. Scope of Application

Article 11 These Provisions apply solely to the trial of debt dispute cases and bankruptcy cases arising from enterprises transferred, dissolved by the military, armed police forces, political and legal organs, and enterprises severed from Party and government organs in this exercise.
